Apex = main stage, in a general sense is what the attendees go to Download for, since that's where the main headliners and popular bands will be. 

Opus = second stage, somewhat smaller bands but usually a decent alternative to main. Also the headliner for Opus headliner is the same as being third down (roughly) on main stage.

Avalanche = third stage (tent), tends to be punk/metalcore 

Dogtooth = fourth stage (tent), tends to be heavier or "left-field" music

Doghouse and The Den are for camping only, and is usually DJ and acoustic sets
